Our conviction in mitapivat for patients with sickle cell disease is grounded in the robust efficacy and safety data generated to date and we are launch-ready ahead of our PDUFA goal date of February 1, 2027.

Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has extended the Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) goal date for its mitapivat sickle cell disease supplemental New Drug Application (sNDA) by three months, from November 1, 2026, to February 1, 2027.
